targets.label: Prometheus rules
targets.description: Recording + multi-window burn-rate alerting rules. Ingestible by Prometheus or Mimir ruler.

targets.label: OTel Collector
targets.description: OpenTelemetry Collector config (receivers / processors / exporters / service.pipelines).

targets.label: Alertmanager
targets.description: Route tree + receivers per severity. Inhibit rules from suppress contexts.

targets.label: Grafana dashboard
targets.description: Grafana dashboard JSON from the pack's boards — the Unified Observability board `<name>-unified`, then one per `spec.dashboards[]` entry — emitted at the schemaVersion of the pack-declared Grafana version; pass the dashboard id as an arg.

targets.label: Blackbox exporter
targets.description: Blackbox exporter modules (blackbox.yml) — one per synthetic check of kind blackbox-exporter, named by the check id; the producer side of the pack's probes. The matching Prometheus scrape jobs are the synthetics/scrape-config artifact.
